title: Test 7 — Adapt illumination power based on bleaching effect. The image shown should be normalise to have the same amount on the different images
agent_prompt: Adjust the light intensity based on the photobleaching effect. For 5 minutes, capture images using the DAPI channel every 30 seconds. Once acquisition is complete, normalise the images so that they can be used for comparison. Save the original images in one folder and the normalised images in another folder. Finally, create a new image by combining the original image with the normalised image side by side. Display all the images in the Napari GUI.  If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Images of side-by-side before and after effect.
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
